verdict.rationale: Browser Use's own docs say developers can have their Playwright/Puppeteer code connect directly over CDP to its cloud browsers instead of letting the agent drive. They also document launching a browser, connecting to its CDP URL, and stopping it, and the vendor positions Browser Infrastructure as a remote browser for your own agents. Missing for 10: in-depth connection docs or code samples for each of Playwright, Puppeteer and raw CDP; independent hands-on corroboration that existing scripts run unmodified.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my existing Playwright, Puppeteer, or CDP automation code to the product's browsers instead of rewriting it

citations.quote: Choose whether Browser Use drives the browser or your Playwright/Puppeteer code connects directly over CDP.
Launch a browser, connect to its CDP URL, then stop it
Browser Infrastructure is the simple cloud browser for your own agents.
